label: Audience & Persona Builder
description: Detailed user/customer profiles, demographics, motivations, and pain points.

fields.label: Primary persona
fields.extraction_hint: One-line description of the primary user or customer (e.g. 'Early-stage SaaS founders aged 28-45').

fields.label: Pain points
fields.extraction_hint: The top 2-5 pain points or frustrations this persona faces.

fields.label: Motivations
fields.extraction_hint: What drives this persona to seek a solution (goals, aspirations, fears).

fields.label: Demographics
fields.extraction_hint: Age range, location, income, education, profession as key/value pairs.

fields.label: Current workarounds
fields.extraction_hint: What they do today to solve or live with the problem (existing tools, manual workarounds).

fields.label: Tech savviness
fields.extraction_hint: How comfortable this persona is with new tools and tech (novice / intermediate / expert).

label: Problem / Opportunity Framer
description: Articulates the specific gap or need the concept addresses.

fields.label: Core problem
fields.extraction_hint: The specific gap or pain in 2-3 sentences.

fields.label: Who has this problem
fields.extraction_hint: Who specifically faces this problem (a short phrase, not the persona dump).

fields.label: Current alternatives
fields.extraction_hint: Existing solutions and why they fall short (each entry: 'Solution X — falls short because Y').

fields.label: Urgency / why now
fields.extraction_hint: What has changed recently to make this problem more pressing.

fields.label: Opportunity size
fields.extraction_hint: Rough sense of how many people are affected or potential market size.

label: Goals & Success Metrics
description: Defines what winning looks like with measurable outcomes.

fields.label: North-star metric
fields.extraction_hint: The one number that defines success (e.g. 'Weekly active users', 'Monthly revenue').

fields.label: Secondary metrics
fields.extraction_hint: 2-4 supporting metrics that ladder up to the north-star.

fields.label: Time horizon
fields.extraction_hint: Timeframe to hit goals (e.g. '6 months', '1 year', '3 years').

fields.label: Target value
fields.extraction_hint: Specific target number for the north-star metric within the horizon.

fields.label: Non-goals
fields.extraction_hint: Things explicitly NOT being optimized for (helps focus).

label: Constraints Mapper
description: Budget, time, skills, regulations, and physical limits.

fields.label: Budget ceiling
fields.extraction_hint: Total budget or budget category (e.g. '<$5k', '$50-100k', 'self-funded').

fields.label: Time constraint
fields.extraction_hint: Hard deadlines or time pressure.

fields.label: Team size
fields.extraction_hint: Number of people involved (e.g. 'solo', '2-3 cofounders', '10-person team').

fields.label: Tech constraints
fields.extraction_hint: Required or forbidden technologies, platforms, languages.

fields.label: Regulatory constraints
fields.extraction_hint: Laws, licenses, certifications that apply.

fields.label: Physical constraints
fields.extraction_hint: Space, equipment, geographic limits.

label: Assumptions Log
description: Surfaces things being taken for granted that should be validated.

fields.label: Assumptions
fields.extraction_hint: List of things being assumed to be true that haven't been validated yet.

fields.label: Top to validate first
fields.extraction_hint: Top 3 highest-risk assumptions to validate first.

fields.label: Evidence so far
fields.extraction_hint: Per-assumption supporting evidence (key=assumption, value=evidence).

label: Audience Validation Planner
description: Methods and questions to test assumptions about target users before building.

fields.label: Interview targets
fields.extraction_hint: Who to talk to and roughly how many (e.g. '10 indie founders, 5 agencies').

fields.label: Key questions to ask
fields.extraction_hint: 3-5 questions that test the core hypotheses.

fields.label: Validation method
fields.extraction_hint: Interviews / surveys / observation / landing-page test / etc.

fields.label: Success criteria
fields.extraction_hint: What signal counts as 'this is real' (e.g. '7 of 10 interviewees say they'd pay').

label: Proof of Concept Planner
description: Defines the smallest testable version and how to test it.

fields.label: Smallest testable version
fields.extraction_hint: The smallest thing that proves or disproves the core idea.

fields.label: Success signal
fields.extraction_hint: What evidence we need to consider the POC successful.

fields.label: Timebox
fields.extraction_hint: Max time to spend on the POC before deciding.

fields.label: Learnings sought
fields.extraction_hint: What questions the POC will answer.

label: Risk Assessment
description: What could go wrong, likelihood, severity, and mitigation strategies.

fields.label: Major risks
fields.extraction_hint: Top risks across technical, market, financial, legal, operational categories.

fields.label: Mitigation strategies
fields.extraction_hint: Per-risk mitigation (key=risk, value=mitigation).

fields.label: Worst plausible outcome
fields.extraction_hint: Worst-case scenario and what triggers it.

label: Regulatory & Compliance Check
description: Legal, licensing, safety, and industry-specific rules.

fields.label: Applicable regulations
fields.extraction_hint: Laws and standards that apply (GDPR, HIPAA, FDA, local licensing, etc.).

fields.label: Licenses & certifications
fields.extraction_hint: Permits, certifications, or registrations required.

fields.label: Data privacy concerns
fields.extraction_hint: PII categories handled and applicable privacy laws.

label: Trend & Timing Analysis
description: Whether the timing is right and why, relevant trend signals.

fields.label: Trend signals
fields.extraction_hint: Recent shifts (tech, regulatory, cultural, economic) that make this timely.

fields.label: Competing trends
fields.extraction_hint: Counter-currents or headwinds that could undermine timing.

fields.label: Timing thesis
fields.extraction_hint: Why now in 2-3 sentences — what makes this the right moment.

label: Team & Resource Planner
description: Who and what is needed, roles, skills gaps, hiring needs.

fields.label: Key roles needed
fields.extraction_hint: Roles required to build this (designer, engineer, marketer, ops, etc.).

fields.label: Skill gaps
fields.extraction_hint: Capabilities the current team lacks.

fields.label: Hiring priorities
fields.extraction_hint: First few hires needed, in priority order.

fields.label: External help
fields.extraction_hint: Contractors, agencies, advisors, mentors needed.

label: Budget & Cost Estimator
description: Full project cost breakdown by phase across all project types.

fields.label: Total budget
fields.extraction_hint: Overall ballpark budget.

fields.label: Phase breakdown
fields.extraction_hint: Per-phase or per-quarter cost split (key=phase, value=dollar amount).

fields.label: Recurring costs
fields.extraction_hint: Monthly/annual subscriptions, salaries, rent, etc.

fields.label: One-time costs
fields.extraction_hint: Setup, hardware, software licenses, legal, etc.

label: Dependency Mapper
description: What must happen before what, critical path identification.

fields.label: Critical path
fields.extraction_hint: Sequenced milestones from start to launch.

fields.label: Blockers
fields.extraction_hint: Things that can't start until X happens.

fields.label: Parallel workstreams
fields.extraction_hint: Streams that can run in parallel without conflict.

label: Operations Planner
description: Day-to-day logistics once the concept is live.

fields.label: Day-to-day rhythm
fields.extraction_hint: What running this looks like on a typical day or week.

fields.label: Operating tools
fields.extraction_hint: CRM, support, project management, accounting tools needed.

fields.label: Escalation paths
fields.extraction_hint: Who handles what when things go wrong.

label: Data Model Planner
description: Entities, relationships, data types, and storage needs.

fields.label: Main entities
fields.extraction_hint: Main data objects (User, Project, Order, Post, etc.).

fields.label: Relationships
fields.extraction_hint: How entities connect (one-to-many, many-to-many, etc.).

fields.label: Data volumes
fields.extraction_hint: Expected scale (number of users, records per user, etc.).

fields.label: Storage needs
fields.extraction_hint: Database, file storage, search engine, etc.

label: Security & Compliance Layer
description: Auth strategy, data protection, privacy, and access control.

fields.label: Auth strategy
fields.extraction_hint: Approach to authentication (OAuth, magic link, custom JWT, etc.).

fields.label: Data classification
fields.extraction_hint: Sensitive data categories (PII, financial, health, etc.).

fields.label: Access control
fields.extraction_hint: Role-based access, attribute-based, multi-tenancy approach.

fields.label: Audit & logging
fields.extraction_hint: Logging, compliance reporting needs.

label: Brand Identity Framework
description: Name, voice, tone, visual language, and core values.

fields.label: Brand name
fields.extraction_hint: Proposed name for the brand or project.

fields.label: Brand voice
fields.extraction_hint: Tone of voice in 2-3 sentences (e.g. 'Warm and authoritative; confident but never preachy').

fields.label: Core values
fields.extraction_hint: 3-5 values that guide brand decisions.

fields.label: Brand promise
fields.extraction_hint: One-line promise to customers.

fields.label: Personality traits
fields.extraction_hint: Adjectives that describe the brand (e.g. 'witty', 'reliable', 'edgy').

label: Design Language Guide
description: Color direction, typography, and style references.

fields.label: Color direction
fields.extraction_hint: The color story — primary, accent, mood.

fields.label: Typography
fields.extraction_hint: Type choices or direction (e.g. 'modern sans-serif, geometric').

fields.label: Visual references
fields.extraction_hint: Mood references — specific brands, products, or styles to look like or not look like.

fields.label: Design principles
fields.extraction_hint: Guiding principles (e.g. 'less is more', 'never two colors', 'always grid-aligned').

label: Narrative & Story Arc
description: Story structure for writing, film, games, or brand storytelling.

fields.label: Premise
fields.extraction_hint: The core premise in 1-3 sentences.

fields.label: Protagonist
fields.extraction_hint: Main character with a one-line description.

fields.label: Central conflict
fields.extraction_hint: The driving conflict that powers the story.

fields.label: Act / beat structure
fields.extraction_hint: Beat sheet or 3-act outline (each entry = one beat or act summary).

fields.label: Themes
fields.extraction_hint: Underlying themes the story explores.

label: Character & World Builder
description: Character profiles, world rules, and lore for fiction, screenplays, and games.

fields.label: Main characters
fields.extraction_hint: Major characters with brief descriptions (name — role — defining trait).

fields.label: World rules
fields.extraction_hint: Setting laws, physics, magic system, or genre conventions.

fields.label: Setting
fields.extraction_hint: Where and when the story takes place.

fields.label: Lore elements
fields.extraction_hint: History, cultures, factions, key events that shape the world.

label: Content Strategy
description: What content is needed, in what format, when, and for whom.

fields.label: Content pillars
fields.extraction_hint: 3-5 main themes or topics content will focus on.

fields.label: Formats
fields.extraction_hint: Blog, video, social, podcast, newsletter, etc.

fields.label: Publishing cadence
fields.extraction_hint: Posting frequency (e.g. '2 blog posts per week, daily social').

fields.label: Distribution channels
fields.extraction_hint: Platforms where content will live (own blog, YouTube, X, LinkedIn, etc.).

label: Creative Direction Brief
description: Visual and tonal reference points, mood board prompts.

fields.label: Mood words
fields.extraction_hint: Adjectives capturing the feel (e.g. 'warm', 'futuristic', 'gritty').

fields.label: Visual references
fields.extraction_hint: Specific brands, films, products, or images to reference.

fields.label: Tone examples
fields.extraction_hint: Comparable brands or products that nail the desired tone.

fields.label: What to avoid
fields.extraction_hint: Aesthetics, references, or vibes to steer clear of.

label: Space Program
description: Areas and rooms needed, their functions and spatial relationships.

fields.label: Required areas
fields.extraction_hint: Rooms or zones needed (kitchen, dining, prep, storage, restroom, etc.).

fields.label: Area sizes
fields.extraction_hint: Rough size per area (key=area, value=sq ft or approximation).

fields.label: Adjacency requirements
fields.extraction_hint: Which areas need to be near each other or kept apart.

label: Materials & Finish Selector
description: Surfaces, textures, and key material choices.

fields.label: Key materials
fields.extraction_hint: Primary materials for floors, walls, surfaces, fixtures.

fields.label: Finish palette
fields.extraction_hint: Overall finish direction in a sentence or two.

fields.label: Sustainability criteria
fields.extraction_hint: Eco / reclaimed / certifications required.

label: Footprint & Flow Diagram
description: How people move through the space or interact with the product.

fields.label: Entry flow
fields.extraction_hint: How users enter and start (first impression, first action).

fields.label: Key interactions
fields.extraction_hint: Main touchpoints or stations during the experience.

fields.label: Exit flow
fields.extraction_hint: How users leave or complete the experience.

label: Vendor & Supplier Map
description: Who provides what physically and sourcing strategy.

fields.label: Vendor categories
fields.extraction_hint: Categories of vendors needed (food, packaging, equipment, etc.).

fields.label: Selection criteria
fields.extraction_hint: How vendors will be evaluated (cost, quality, location, ethics).

fields.label: Backup options
fields.extraction_hint: Per-category backup vendor (key=category, value=backup approach).

label: Equipment & Inventory List
description: Hardware, tools, stock, and physical assets needed.

fields.label: Equipment needed
fields.extraction_hint: Major items required (hardware, machines, tools, fixtures).

fields.label: Quantities
fields.extraction_hint: How many of each (key=item, value=count).

fields.label: Buy / rent / lease
fields.extraction_hint: Overall acquisition approach.

label: Launch Strategy
description: How and when to introduce this to the world.

fields.label: Target launch date
fields.extraction_hint: Date or rough window for launch.

fields.label: Launch phases
fields.extraction_hint: Soft launch / beta / public phases with rough dates.

fields.label: Launch channels
fields.extraction_hint: Where the launch will happen (Product Hunt, press, community, etc.).

fields.label: First-week success indicators
fields.extraction_hint: Metrics that show launch went well.

label: Distribution & Channel Planner
description: How it reaches its audience and channel mix.

fields.label: Primary channels
fields.extraction_hint: Main distribution channels (direct sales, app stores, retail, content, etc.).

fields.label: Channel economics
fields.extraction_hint: Per-channel cost vs reach (key=channel, value=note).

fields.label: Channel dependencies
fields.extraction_hint: Platform requirements or risks per channel.

label: Pricing Strategy
description: How value is captured and pricing model options.

fields.label: Pricing model
fields.extraction_hint: Subscription / one-time / freemium / usage-based / tiered / etc.

fields.label: Price points
fields.extraction_hint: Specific tier names + prices.

fields.label: Pricing rationale
fields.extraction_hint: Why this pricing (anchoring, value-based, competitive).

label: Marketing & Messaging Framework
description: What to say, where to say it, and to whom.

fields.label: Value proposition
fields.extraction_hint: The core value proposition in 1-2 sentences.

fields.label: Key messages
fields.extraction_hint: 3-5 messages that support the value prop.

fields.label: Audience segments
fields.extraction_hint: Per-segment messaging variations.

fields.label: Proof points
fields.extraction_hint: Evidence supporting the messages (stats, testimonials, demos).

label: Partnership & Outreach Map
description: Collaborators, press, influencers, and key relationships.

fields.label: Target partner categories
fields.extraction_hint: Categories of partners (distributors, integrators, press, influencers).

fields.label: Named targets
fields.extraction_hint: Specific companies or individuals to approach.

fields.label: Value exchange
fields.extraction_hint: What we offer partners / what we want from them.

label: Community & Retention Plan
description: How to keep people engaged after launch.

fields.label: Community format
fields.extraction_hint: Discord / forum / events / newsletter / etc.

fields.label: Engagement rituals
fields.extraction_hint: Recurring touchpoints (weekly digest, AMAs, office hours).

fields.label: Retention metrics
fields.extraction_hint: Metrics that measure stickiness (DAU/MAU, repeat purchase, churn).

label: Revenue Model Designer
description: How this makes money, model options, and unit economics.

fields.label: Revenue streams
fields.extraction_hint: All the ways this makes money (subscription, transactions, ads, services, etc.).

fields.label: Unit economics
fields.extraction_hint: Per-unit profit math (CAC, LTV, gross margin).

fields.label: Pricing tiers
fields.extraction_hint: If subscription, the tier names and prices.

label: Financial Projection Builder
description: Basic P&L, break-even, cash flow, and projections.

fields.label: Year 1 revenue target
fields.extraction_hint: Revenue goal for year 1.

fields.label: Breakeven timeline
fields.extraction_hint: When we expect to break even.

fields.label: Monthly burn rate
fields.extraction_hint: Expected monthly cost to operate.

fields.label: Growth assumptions
fields.extraction_hint: Key assumptions driving the projections.

label: Funding & Investment Map
description: Bootstrapped, grants, investors, and crowdfunding paths.

fields.label: Funding path
fields.extraction_hint: Bootstrap / friends-family / angel / VC / grants / crowdfund / revenue.

fields.label: Funding milestones
fields.extraction_hint: Round sizes and what each round unlocks.

fields.label: Current runway
fields.extraction_hint: Months of runway available before needing more funding.

label: Business Model Canvas
description: Lean one-page business structure overview.

fields.label: Value proposition
fields.extraction_hint: The center of the canvas — the value delivered to customers.

fields.label: Customer segments
fields.extraction_hint: Who we serve, segmented.

fields.label: Revenue streams
fields.extraction_hint: How we capture value.

fields.label: Key activities
fields.extraction_hint: What we do daily to deliver value.

fields.label: Key resources
fields.extraction_hint: What we need (people, IP, capital, infrastructure).

fields.label: Cost structure
fields.extraction_hint: Major cost categories.

fields.label: Key partners
fields.extraction_hint: Who we work with to deliver value.

fields.label: Customer relationships
fields.extraction_hint: Type of relationship (self-serve, high-touch, community-driven).

fields.label: Channels
fields.extraction_hint: How we reach and deliver to customers.

label: Legal & IP Planner
description: Entity type, IP protection strategy, and key contracts needed.

fields.label: Entity type
fields.extraction_hint: Sole prop / LLC / C-corp / B-corp / nonprofit / etc.

fields.label: IP strategy
fields.extraction_hint: Trademarks, patents, copyrights, trade secrets to protect.

fields.label: Contracts needed
fields.extraction_hint: Founder agreement, employment, customer ToS, vendor agreements, NDAs.

label: Production Bible
description: Full reference doc: characters, world rules, tone, chapter/episode breakdowns.

fields.label: Outline
fields.extraction_hint: Chapter, episode, or scene breakdown.

fields.label: Tone & voice
fields.extraction_hint: How it reads or sounds — narrative voice, pacing, prose style.

fields.label: Comparable works
fields.extraction_hint: Comparable books, films, or shows for tone/structure.

fields.label: Format specs
fields.extraction_hint: Length, format, target channel (e.g. '8-episode limited series, 60 min each').

label: Investor Deck Outline
description: Structured framework for a funding presentation.

fields.label: Pitch hook
fields.extraction_hint: The opening line that grabs investor attention.

fields.label: Key slides
fields.extraction_hint: Slide-by-slide structure (10-15 slides, each with a one-line summary).

fields.label: The ask
fields.extraction_hint: Specific funding ask — amount, use of funds, milestones it unlocks.
